summary: North Mini Code is Cohere's first agentic coding model and the debut of its North family — a sparse MoE with 30B total / 3B active parameters — free via OpenRouter's :free endpoint at bash prompt / bash completion with a 256K context. Created 2026-06-17; no published end date.
claim_steps: Sign up at openrouter.ai and create an API key (no card needed for :free models).
Call the chat completions API with model id cohere/north-mini-code:free.
